rca of the issue: Original 'TypeError: map is not a function' RCA: Frontend was calling .map on API responses without validating shape; combined with the risk of an errored/non-array response from the backend during deploy. Fix verified: (1) backend explicitly returns List[Product] for /api/products and {count, ingredients:[]} for /api/ingredients — confirmed via tests. (2) Frontend has defensive Array.isArray/ensureArray guards. Both layers now correct.
